recovered_from: ROADMAP, Cleanshot history, Pine rules, tactical commits and trading-assistant requirements

hypotheses.idea: BTC/ETH market regime as cross-symbol context
hypotheses.old_status: planned and historically discussed, not isolated in causal A/B
hypotheses.test_plan: Add only closed BTC/ETH 4H/1D regime features; compare against an otherwise identical no-market-context control.

hypotheses.old_status: planned; session existed in early Structure keys but was not independently validated
hypotheses.test_plan: Measure setup-family performance by UTC session and weekday first; only then test a soft risk modifier, never post-hoc hard blocks.

hypotheses.idea: Different maximum holding time for breakout, pullback, range and liquidity setups
hypotheses.old_status: planned; current risk model uses one global maximum holding period
hypotheses.test_plan: Estimate causal MFE/MAE and time-to-target per setup family, then compare family-specific time stops against the global time-stop control.

hypotheses.idea: trend_friendly, volatile_clean, watch_only, chaotic_avoid and insufficient_history symbol classes
hypotheses.old_status: documented but not proven as a causal production gate
hypotheses.test_plan: Build classes from completed rolling history only; compare soft risk/ranking against no-class control before any hard exclusion.

hypotheses.idea: Open interest, funding, liquidation maps, order book and cluster context
hypotheses.old_status: discussed in Cleanshot and later market-scanner requirements; not integrated into SMOKE history
hypotheses.test_plan: Acquire timestamped historical derivatives data with known publication time, coverage and survivorship rules; test each feature as an overlay against a candle-only control.

hypotheses.idea: Liquidity state, candle type, direction and minimum volume-ratio tactical filters
hypotheses.old_status: historical candidates used high_sweep_reject, bear_rejection, direction-up and volume-ratio filters
hypotheses.test_plan: For surviving setup families, run a predeclared A/B: no micro filter, each filter alone, and combined filter; use the full universe and frozen folds.

hypotheses.idea: 1D narrative plus completed 4H context plus 15M entry, with optional 5M timing
hypotheses.old_status: became the old final baseline but causal validation later failed
hypotheses.test_plan: Compare entry-only, 4H-only, 1D+4H aligned, conflict-as-risk-reduction and conflict-as-hard-block variants on identical setup families.

hypotheses.idea: Stop beyond swing, fractal, Donchian boundary or POI with ATR reserve
hypotheses.old_status: central Pine/user rule but replaced in SMOKE by fixed setup stop percentages
hypotheses.test_plan: Build causal structural stop candidates from information available at entry; compare against current fixed-percent stops while holding entries and targets constant.

hypotheses.idea: Risk grade and confidence should predict realised outcomes
hypotheses.old_status: risk grades drive labels and risk but were not independently proven
hypotheses.test_plan: Measure OOS calibration by grade: sample count, hit rate, average R, PF, MFE/MAE and monotonicity before using grade as a hard gate.
